Important Information

Surcharges

Additional charges may apply when specific shipment characteristics or service requirements require handling beyond the standard DHL Express offering.

Jump to

  • Surcharges
  • Fuel Surcharges

Surcharges

Applies to shipments that require special handling, documentation, and compliance procedures. 

SurchargeDescriptionHow We ChargeCost
Full Dangerous GoodsShipping Dangerous Goods
A surcharge is applied per shipment when the handling and transportation of TDI shipments involves substances and commodities classified as fully regulated in accordance with the IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations. DG class 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8 and 9 commodities, according to IATA regulations. DHL Express does not accept:
Explosive material of Class 1
Class 2.3 toxic gas
Class 3: UN1204, UN2059, UN3064, UN3343, UN3357, UN3379
Class 4.1: UN1310, UN1320, UN1321, UN1322, UN1336, UN1337, UN1344, UN1347, UN1348, UN1349, UN1354, UN1355, UN1356, UN1357, UN1517, UN1571, UN2555, UN2556, UN2557, UN2852, UN2907, UN3317, UN3319, UN3344, UN3364, UN3365, UN3366, UN3367, UN3368, UN3369, UN3370, UN3376, UN3380, UN3474
Class 6.2 infectious substance except UN3373
Radioactive material of Class 7 including Excepted Packages.
To find out more about shipping Dangerous Goods, please contact Customer Service.

Contractual agreement required.		Per ShipmentAUD 249
Excepted QuantitiesShipping Dangerous Goods in Excepted Quantities
This fixed surcharge is applied when the handling and transportation of shipments involves substances and commodities that are in Excepted Quantities in compliance with IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations.

Contractual agreement required.		Per ShipmentAUD 16
Dry Ice UN1845When cool is not cold enough
A surcharge is applied when the transportation of shipments involves handling Dry Ice UN1845 as a freezing agent for non-dangerous goods such as diagnostic specimens.

Contractual agreement required.		Per ShipmentAUD 20
Consumer Goods ID8000Packages containing perfumes and prescription medicine intended for retail.
A surcharge is applied for shipments containing consumer goods such as perfumes, aftershaves, aerosols, nail varnish and prescription medicines as covered by the IATA ID8000 section and packed in a form intended for retail sale and shipped to private individuals (B2C).

To find out more about shipping Dangerous Goods, please contact Customer Service.

Contractual agreement required.		Per ShipmentAUD 30
Lithium Batteries (with Equipment) - Lithium Ion PI966, Section II, Lithium Metal PI969, Section II

Shipping lithium batteries with equipment

Lithium Ion PI966, Section II

A service charge will be assessed on Lithium Ion batteries with equipment. Packaging must be compliant with the appropriate IATA Packing Instruction 966, Section II and are accepted from approved shippers only.

Lithium Metal PI969, Section II

A service charge will be assessed on Lithium Metal batteries with equipment. Packaging must be compliant with the appropriate IATA Packing Instruction 969, Section II and are accepted from approved shippers only.

Per ShipmentAUD 8
Lithium Batteries (in Equipment) - Lithium Ion PI967, Section II, Lithium Metal PI970, Section II

Shipping lithium batteries in equipment

Lithium Batteries (with Equipment) - Lithium Ion PI966, Section II, Lithium Metal PI969, Section II

Lithium Ion PI967, Section II

Shipments containing Lithium Ion batteries in equipment are accepted only in compliance with the approriate IATA Packing Instruction 967, Section II.

Lithium Metal PI970, Section II

Shipments containing Lithium Metal batteries in equipment are accepted only in compliance with the approriate IATA Packing Instruction 970, Section II.

DHL

reserves the right to reject shipments known or suspected to contain defective or damaged batteries.

Per ShipmentNo Charge
Biological Substances UN3373Shipping biological substances
Shipments containing Biological Substances Category B (UN3373) or genetically modified organisms as per UN3245 are only accepted in combination with DHL Medical Express.

Contractual agreement required.		Per ShipmentNo Charge

Applies when collecting from or delivering to locations outside standard DHL Express service areas. 

SurchargeDescriptionHow We ChargeCost
Remote Area DeliveryWhen shipping to a remote area
DHL Express applies a surcharge per shipment when the pick up or delivery destination location is remote. Remote is defined as distant islands and highlands, a postal code, suburb or town that is difficult, inaccessible or infrequently served.		Per ShipmentAUD 40 or AUD 1.0 per kg, if higher
Remote Area Pickup
Importing shipments from remote pickup locations
DHL Express applies a surcharge per shipment when the pick up or delivery destination location is remote. Remote is defined as distant islands and highlands, a postal code, suburb or town that is difficult, inaccessible or infrequently served.		Per ShipmentAUD 40 or AUD 1.0 per kg, if higher

Check for Remote Locations

Applies to shipments to or from destinations classified as elevated risk or subject to trade restrictions. 

SurchargeDescriptionHow We ChargeCost
Elevated RiskCountries where DHL Express operates at elevated risk.
A surcharge is applied when shipping to or importing from a destination country, DHL Express is operating at elevated risk due to continuous state of war, civil unrest, or continuous threats from terrorism. The list of destination countries in scope is published online as part of the respective surcharge table. This charge may apply in addition to either Restricted Destination or Exporter Validation.
 
Countries affected (subject to change): Afghanistan, Burkina Faso, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Haiti, Iraq, Lebanon, Libya, Mali, Somalia Mogadishu, Sudan, Syria, Ukraine, Venezuela, and Yemen.		Per ShipmentAUD 52.5
Restricted DestinationShipping in compliance with trade restrictions
A surcharge applies when shipping to or importing from a destination country that is subject to specific trade restrictions imposed by the UN Security Council or by national legislation such as the European Union or the US Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC).
 
Countries affected (subject to change): Central African Republic, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Iran, Iraq, North Korea, Libya, Somalia Mogadishu and Yemen
 
Countries subject to national legislation (subject to change): Afghanistan, Belarus, Cuba, Lebanon, Myanmar, Russia		Per ShipmentAUD 52.5

Applies when shipment or billing information requires correction after submission, including address updates. 

SurchargeDescriptionHow We ChargeCost
Address CorrectionOur priority is to get your shipment in the right hands.
A surcharge is applied per shipment when the destination address provided by the shipper is incomplete, outdated or incorrect and DHL Express is subsequently unable to deliver the shipment. DHL Express searches and determines the correct address to complete the delivery.		Per ShipmentAUD 20
Data EntryManual Entry Data by DHL Express
A surcharge applies if the shipping label is not correctly completed or has not been produced electronically according to DHL Express standards and therefore requires manual data entry by DHL Express.		Per ShipmentAUD 20

Applies to shipments that require special handling due to size, weight, packaging, or stacking limitations. 

SurchargeDescriptionHow We ChargeCost
Overweight PieceShipment pieces exceeding 70 kg
A fixed surcharge is applied to every piece, including a pallet, that exceeds a scale or volumetric weight of 150 lbs. for shipments originating in the U.S. and U.S. Territories (70 kg. for shipments originating outside of the U.S. and U.S. Territories).		Per Piece100.00 AUD
Non-Stackable PalletWhen shipping non-stackable pallets
This fixed surcharge is applied to every pallet within a shipment that cannot be stacked, either on request by the shipper, or because of its shape, content or packaging material. Does not apply to pallets below 25 kg.		Per Pallet493.50 AUD (International) / 247AUD (Domestic)
Additonal Handling

Dimension
A fixed surcharge applies to every piece, including a pallet, if its longest side exceeds 100cm or its second-longest side exceeds 80cm.
Weight
A surcharge applies every piece with an actual weight between 25kg and 70kg.
Packaging 
This surcharge applies to any shipment that piece that meets one or more of the following criteria:

  • Is not fully enclosed in the outer shipping container,
  • Is packaged in materials other than corrugated cardboard, such as metal, wood, leather, hard or soft plastic, or expanded ploystyrene foam,
  • Is wrapped in shrink wrap or stretch wrap,
  • Has a roundor cylindrical shape,  such as buckets, cans, drums, tires, or barrels, 
  • Includes wheels, handles, or straps,
  • Has the potential to become entangled with or cause damage to other packages or the handling systems.

Additional handling does not apply to pieces already subject to Overweight Piece surcharge.

Per Piece25 AUD

Applies to shipments that require special handling due to size, weight, packaging, or stacking limitations. 

SurchargeDescriptionHow We Charge and Cost 
Emergency SituationService continuation in emergency situations
A temporary surcharge, which allows us to cover operating cost increases due to an emergency situation out of DHL Express' control. Change in market dynamics and air capacity availability is reflected through regular price adjustments.		Service status and impacted countries
Demand Surcharge
Demand Surcharges may apply to shipment during a period of high demand
A period of high demand is to be determined by DHL Express at its own discretion but may include a time of high demand for shipping services or a period with high operational cost. Demand Surcharges apply cumulatively if a shipment and/or individual pieces meet more than one of the specified criteria.		Service status and impacted countries

More about Surcharges

Additional surcharges may apply depending on shipment characteristics. All rates and surcharges are exclusive of VAT unless otherwise stated. DHL reserves the right to amend rates, surcharges, transit times, services, and zones without prior notice and in accordance with the DHL Terms and Conditions. 

Fuel Surcharge

The fuel surcharge for all services will be based on the daily average spot prices for US Gulf Coast (USGC) kerosene-type jet fuel, as reported by the U.S. Department of Energy between 3rd week release of prior month to 3rd week release of actual month. 

Updated: July 20, 2026

Effective: August 03, 2026

The fuel surcharge for all services will be based on the daily average spot prices for US Gulf Coast (USGC) kerosene-type jet fuel, as reported by the U.S. Department of Energy between third week release of prior month to third week release of actual month.

For example, the daily average price for fuel from 18th of April to 15th of May is used to determine the applicable surcharge in June.

The fuel surcharge applies to the transportation charges and to the following services and surcharges (where applicable):

  • Dedicated Delivery
  • Dedicated Pickup
  • Demand Surcharge
  • Elevated Risk
  • Emergency Situation
  • Non-Conveyable Piece
  • Non-Stackable Pallet
  • Oversize Piece
  • Overweight Piece
  • Remote Area Delivery
  • Remote Area Pickup
  • Residential Address
  • Saturday Delivery
  • Saturday Pickup

DHL Express reserves the right to change the fuel surcharge index and table with or without notice. Both the amount and duration of the surcharge will be determined at DHL Express' sole discretion.
